titulo: ‘Body’ found in suitcase near Goulburn was actually lifelike doll with ‘bruises and grazes’
cuerpo: What was originally reported as a body found in Oallen on Sunday was ‘very realistic in the terms of looking like human remains’, NSW police say Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast What appeared to be a woman’s body found in a suitcase by the side of a road near Goulburn in regional New South Wales was in fact a lifelike doll with markings resembling bruises and grazes, police say. NSW police said they were called to Wolgon Road in Oallen about 12.50pm on Sunday “following reports a body had been located”. Continue reading...
